assumptions.choice: Added a self.order tracking attribute reset in notify_order on Completed/Canceled/Margin/Rejected to prevent duplicate orders while one is pending
assumptions.reason: Canonical default #5; spec is silent on pending-order handling

assumptions.choice: Skip entry (no order placed) if floor(0.10 * value / close) evaluates to 0
assumptions.reason: Spec defines the sizing formula but does not address the degenerate case of a zero-share result; placing a zero-size order is not meaningful

assumptions.choice: Relied on the position-flag check (self.position) combined with the RSI>70 entry condition; no additional state variable needed since exit sets position to flat and a new entry naturally requires RSI to cross back above 70
assumptions.reason: The spec's single-entry and re-entry rules are already the natural consequence of gating entries on 'not in position' plus the RSI>70 condition — no extra flag needed
